nights.title: Terrace Martin
nights.name: Terrace Martin
nights.extract: Terrace Jamahl Martin is an American musician, rapper, singer, and record producer. He is perhaps best known for producing records for several prominent artists in the music industry, including Kendrick Lamar, Snoop Dogg, the Game, Busta Rhymes, Stevie Wonder, Charlie Wilson, Raphael Saadiq and YG, among others. Martin is a multi-instrumentalist whose music production embodies funk, jazz, classical and soul. Martin released his sixth studio album, Velvet Portraits, on his label, Sounds of Crenshaw Records, through Ropeadope Records.

nights.title: Kenny Garrett
nights.name: Kenny Garrett
nights.extract: Kenny Garrett is an American post-bop jazz musician and composer who gained recognition in his youth as a member of the Duke Ellington Orchestra and for his time with Miles Davis's band. Garrett's primary instruments are alto and soprano saxophone and flute. Since 1985, he has pursued a solo career.

en.kicker: american jazz saxophonist and composer · post-bop
en.who: Kenny Garrett is an American post-bop jazz musician and composer. He gained recognition in his youth as a member of the Duke Ellington Orchestra and for his time with Miles Davis's band. His primary instruments are alto and soprano saxophone and flute, and he has pursued a solo career since 1985.
facts: Kenny Garrett is an American post-bop jazz musician and composer who gained recognition in his youth as a member of the Duke Ellington Orchestra and for his time with Miles Davis's band.

de.who: Kenny Garrett ist ein amerikanischer Post-Bop-Jazzmusiker und Komponist. In seiner Jugend wurde er als Mitglied des Duke Ellington Orchestra bekannt, außerdem durch seine Zeit in der Band von Miles Davis. Seine Hauptinstrumente sind Alt- und Sopransaxophon sowie Flöte; seit 1985 verfolgt er eine Solokarriere.

tr.who: Kenny Garrett, Amerikalı bir post-bop caz müzisyeni ve bestecisidir. Gençliğinde Duke Ellington Orkestrası üyesi olarak ve Miles Davis'in grubundaki dönemiyle tanındı. Başlıca enstrümanları alto ve soprano saksafon ile flüttür; 1985'ten beri solo kariyer izliyor.
